title: How to Choose the Right Entertainment for Your Event
excerpt: From weddings to corporate galas, the right act sets the tone for the whole night. Here is how we help clients pick performers that match their vision.
body:
## Start with the feeling, not the act

Before choosing a DJ, band, or solo vocalist, decide how you want guests to *feel* across the night. A relaxed drinks reception calls for a saxophonist or acoustic set, while a late-night celebration thrives on a high-energy DJ.

## Match the act to the room

Venue size, acoustics, and power supply all shape what is possible. Our team handles the technical side so you can focus on the experience.

## Book early

The best performers get reserved months in advance, especially in peak wedding season. Reach out early to secure your first choice.

> Need a hand? [Get in touch](/contact) and we'll build a bespoke recommendation.
